confidentUnsupported.evidence: 'The most common cause for this dead state is a faulty mains lead or a failed internal power filter' and later 'The most likely cause is a fault in the mains lead or the internal power supply unit'

rationale: The assistant never asked the single most sensible question for an integrated machine with working kitchen sockets: whether there is a switch above the worktop or a fused spur for the washer, nor did it suggest checking the consumer unit. Instead it jumped straight to internal faults ('faulty mains lead', 'failed internal power filter', 'power supply unit') with unwarranted confidence and showed a replacement-part panel for an unknown model. It also ignored what the customer had said, asking her to 'switch it off at the wall socket' right after she explained the plug was unreachable behind the built-in unit. The engineer escalation was safe but premature and would have cost a renter a callout for a switch that was simply off.
